usBTS12Months.publisher: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics

shareOfDelayedFlightsDerived.note: Derived: each cause / 21.67 (sum of delay causes). Delayed = arrival 15+ min late; causes prorated by minutes, so these are shares of delayed-flight equivalents. Extreme weather is part of the 'weather' figure only; weather inside NAS is counted under NAS.

cancellationCauses.note: BTS summary page does not break cancellations down by cause; the on-time database has a cancellation code field but it was not queried.

ukCAA2025.publisher: UK Civil Aviation Authority, 2025 Annual Punctuality Statistics Summary Analysis (run 25/02/2026)

onTimePercent.unit: % of matched flights early or within 15 min late (arrivals and departures, 25 reporting airports)
onTimePercent.note: Derived by weighting the 25 AIRPORT TOTAL rows by matched flights (1,910,591); matches the CAA's published 72.7%.

averageDelayMinutes.note: Derived weighted mean; matches the CAA's published 15.1.

delayedOver3hPercent.unit: % of matched flights more than 180 min late (181-360 plus 360+ bands)
delayedOver3hPercent.note: Derived from the CSV bands; 121-180 min band adds 0.97%. Counts arrivals and departures at UK airports.

delayCauses.note: The CAA does not publish delay causes.

august2026.note: Minutes per flight from 1 min onward, by IATA delay code (Airline = codes 0-69, 97; Reactionary = 90-96). Reactionary delay is knock-on and mixes all primary causes. CODA coverage 55.3% of flights; partial data.

year2025.note: Reactionary is the largest cause (-19% vs 2024), airline delays -13%; the per-cause minute values are chart images and were not extractable. En-route ATFM 1.7 min/flight, airport ATFM 0.7.

canadaCTA.note: The CTA does not publish a share of delays or cancellations within the airline's control. None found.

euDelayed3hPlus.note: No EU-wide official share of flights 3h+ late found; EUROCONTROL publishes only a 'Del > 60' band.

appr.conditions: Disruption within the airline's control and not required for safety; notified 14 days or less before departure; arrival at final destination 3+ hours late; written claim within 1 year; airline has 30 days to respond.

amendmentsInForce.note: Page reads 'current to 2026-09-21 and last amended on 2022-09-08'. The amendments proposed in Canada Gazette Part I on 2024-12-21 had not come into force as of that date; the 2022 refund amendments (SOR/2022-134, in force 2022-09-08) are the latest.

eu261.threeHourRule: Passengers reaching the final destination 3 hours or more late are entitled to compensation unless extraordinary circumstances apply.
eu261.fiftyPercentReduction: Compensation may be reduced by 50% when re-routed passengers arrive within set time limits.
eu261.note: The Irish regulator's old passenger-rights URL (aviationreg.ie) now redirects to iaa.ie and was not re-read. The Council's 2025 reform position (longer thresholds) is not reflected on the page, so the 3h rule stands as of the check date.

uncertain: BC Ferries sailing counts come from the live departures board for a single day (Wed 30 Sep 2026), not the printed fall schedule, which is behind a queue page. HSB-NAN shows a gap from 13:25 to 18:20 that may be a cancelled sailing.
HSB-Departure Bay crossing time (100 min) is inferred from actual departure and arrival times; the live page states 1h42m for one sailing.
The FY2025 BC Ferries controllable-delay share (33.1%) depends on the order of labels in the chart.
Stena foot fare column-to-period mapping (EUR 44 vs 49; GBP 38 vs 42) is uncertain from the text extraction.
Irish Ferries foot fare: not published.
Avanti direct Holyhead-Euston trains per day: not counted, because the timetable text was unreadable. Anytime single fare not found.
TransLink zone count for downtown to Tsawwassen (3 zones) and Canada Line minutes were not read on-page.
The UK CAA figures are derived from the CSV (weighted), not quoted headline numbers, but match the CAA's published 72.7% / 15.1 min.
EUROCONTROL monthly figures are based on partial CODA data (55-61% coverage).
